text:
[NERR.12.1] Raised when a declared cap would be exceeded: one of the caps
[LERR.1.5] names, of which the integration sets the cache bounds
([NSTG.2.6.1]). The other realtime codes are [NERR.18]'s.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_BREACH` | a declared cap would be exceeded; the operation is refused and the engine stays usable |
